# Butler's Construction & Service Solutions

> Licensed Las Vegas general contractor for kitchen and bathroom remodeling, new home construction, commercial build-outs, plumbing, restoration, and property maintenance. Serving Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Summerlin, Paradise, Enterprise, and Spring Valley.

Hours: Mon-Fri 7AM-6PM, Sat 8AM-4PM
